constitution.worker: The profile worker schedules explicit invocations and validates identity/schema/finite values/geometry/directives; it does not turn evidence into a hidden strategy.

items.title: Keep the SQLite decision index synchronized after bootstrap
resolution: Make SQLite the operational query authority and append every new decision through ProfileStateStore in the cycle write path.
Persist an incremental identity or offset cursor for idempotent bootstrap and detect JSONL/SQLite divergence at startup.
Treat corruption or partial synchronization as an explicit degraded state rather than returning a silently stale tail.
acceptance: Sequential decisions are immediately visible in tail_decisions and restart neither duplicates nor loses them.
Bootstrap processes only missing records and tests cover concurrent write, crash between stores, truncation, and migration.
Cognition never receives a silently frozen decision history.
deployment: Add a red regression test, rebuild a copied state store, and shadow-compare JSONL with SQLite.
Back up operator state before upgrade and validate rollback.
Publish only in a paired release after checksums and soak; block live until fixed.

items.title: Bound JSONL journal growth and tail-read cost
resolution: Implement byte- and line-bounded reverse tail reads plus configurable size/time rotation and retention.
Use indexed SQLite for frequent queries and expose file sizes, cursors, disk growth, and oldest retained evidence.
Compact only under lock with atomic replace and fsync while preserving checksummed audit archives.
acceptance: Tail memory and latency stay bounded for multi-gigabyte journals.
Rotation preserves ordering without loss or duplication and readers tolerate a concurrent rotation.
Soak evidence reports disk growth per hour and p95 read latency.
deployment: Collect baseline metrics, test against a large copied journal, then enable rotation default-off.
Validate recovery before making bounded retention the next paired-release default.

items.title: Make the intent outbox crash-durable and reconcile ambiguity before discard

Before discarding a missing-frame intent, query the gateway by intent_id and retain ambiguity while unavailable.
acceptance: Kill injection at every persistence stage converges without accepting partial state.
A known receipt is recovered, an unavailable gateway keeps delivery_unknown, and no blind retry duplicates mutation.
Windows replace, fsync, restart, and operator-visible SLA tests pass.
deployment: Migrate the outbox format backward-compatibly and run the local fault matrix.
Complete restart soak and an approved PRAC timeout-after-registration scenario.

items.title: Make SQLite the atomic authority for decision journaling
items.finding: SQLite commits before decisions.jsonl, so a fault creates split-brain history; COUNT(*) is not a safe source cursor after divergence.
resolution: Make SQLite the sole operational decision authority with a unique packet/intent identity.
Persist decision and export-outbox row in one FULL/WAL transaction.
Project JSONL asynchronously from a durable sequence cursor with idempotent replay and fsync.
Replace COUNT(*) synchronization with generation, byte offset, sequence, and content-integrity metadata.
Quarantine migration conflicts and expose a degraded state instead of silently choosing one copy.
acceptance: Kill injection before, during, and after export converges to one SQLite decision and one JSONL row.
Retry and restart never duplicate packet_id or intent_id.
A read-only migration report detects every JSONL/SQLite mismatch before upgrade.
Cognition tail stays current and bounded after restart and rotation.
deployment: Back up operator state and run the divergence report.
Deploy schema and exporter disabled, then shadow-compare projections.
Enable projection after crash/restart soak and remove synchronous dual-write only after parity.
Publish only in a paired release; armed promotion remains blocked while open.

items.title: Make journal reads incremental and retention bounded
items.finding: Decision tail synchronization and learning/calibration paths still perform full JSONL scans, while general journal rotation is absent.
resolution: Import only appended bytes using durable generation/offset/sequence cursors.
Serve operational tails and learning pages from indexed SQLite.
Add generation-aware size/time rotation, checksummed archives, and explicit recovery/learning/audit retention classes.
Expose cursor lag, file size, disk growth, and p95 read latency.
acceptance: Tail memory and latency remain bounded on multi-gigabyte fixtures.
Concurrent append, rotation, and restart lose or duplicate zero records.
Paginated learning output is semantically equivalent to the current full scan.
The one-minute cycle remains inside its documented deadline during soak.
deployment: Capture baseline metrics on copied state.
Ship rotation default-off and shadow-compare readers.
Enable retention gradually with archive restore and rollback rehearsal.

items.title: Require the immutable gateway pair for promotable profile releases
items.finding: Profile release accepts a nullable gateway_commit even though armed operation requires an exact compatible pair.
resolution: Require gateway SHA/version, profile SHA/version, protocol, prompt, effective-config hash, and evidence reference in one signed manifest.
Validate byte-identical pair metadata in both release workflows.
Mark standalone artifacts explicitly non-promotable and surface the active pair in status.
acceptance: Armed-promotable release fails on absent, nullable, mutable, or incompatible pair fields.
Both repositories attest the same pair manifest.
Rollback selects a prior attested pair and preserves durable recovery state.
Human environment approval remains mandatory.
deployment: Introduce a non-blocking pair validator.
Build a rehearsal artifact and complete a rollback drill.
Make the manifest required in both armed-production workflows.

items.title: Add incremental lint, typing, branch coverage, and mutation gates
items.finding: Critical Python workflows lack enforced Ruff/type gates and risk-based branch/mutation coverage despite compile, unittest, checksum, quality, and CodeQL checks.
resolution: Add Ruff and Pyright or mypy incrementally to persistence, delivery, gateway-client, and workflow modules.
Measure branch coverage for crash, discard, retry, and restart paths.
Use selective mutation testing to prove unsafe 404 deletion and dual-write variants are rejected.
Compile/import workflow packages explicitly on Linux and Windows and ratchet baselines.
acceptance: Critical modules are lint and type clean.
Every re-audit regression has a branch assertion and coverage cannot silently decrease.
Mutation tests kill unsafe terminal/discard/write-order changes.
Credential-free CI remains deterministic on both supported operating systems.
deployment: Start reporting-only, fix critical modules, require by directory, then ratchet the full profile.

promotion_gate: No armed promotion while any P0 re-audit item is open.
All critical fault regressions must be red-before-fix and green-after-fix.
A paired Sim/PRAC soak, rollback rehearsal, and human approval are required.
